test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All goats are animals.

Some animals are carnivores.

**Conclusions:**

(I) All goats are carnivores.

(II) Some animals are goats.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56c7902988d7f2a4dc910d560aa209d370aac88948c3bb61cfa7d7015dc5389d.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All goats are carnivores. → False (As, there is no definite relation between goats are carnivores. Hence, false)

(II) Some animals are goats. → True (As, all goats are animals)

Hence, **only conclusion II follows**.
